headlines.title: Mondelēz International and Accenture Transform Order-to-Cash With AI
headlines.summary: NEW YORK & CHICAGO, November 05, 2026--Mondelēz International and Accenture are collaborating to transform Mondelēz's end-to-end Order-to-Cash process through agentic AI.

headlines.title: Accenture vs. Oracle: Which Technology Stock Is a Better Buy in 2027?
headlines.summary: Oracle's cloud revenue has grown to about half of its sales, while Accenture's consulting franchise serves roughly three-quarters of the Fortune Global 500, but the two balance sheets point in opposite directions.

headlines.title: 3 Stocks Showing Impressive Relative Strength: LMT, ACN, NUE
headlines.summary: Several stocks have quietly shown a high level of relative strength over the past month, including Lockheed Martin (LMT), Accenture (ACN), and Nucor (NUE) thanks to strong quarterly results.

headlines.title: Does Earnings Beat Change The Bull Case For Accenture Stock (ACN)?
headlines.summary: In October 2026, TÜV SÜD AG and Accenture presented a Physical AI Safety Suite at NVIDIA GTC Berlin, using digital twins, AI agents and simulations to accelerate independent certification of industrial automation. TÜV SÜD estimates that this could bring production online up to 30% sooner. The Physical AI Safety Suite and Accenture’s new Center of Excellence for physical AI signal a push toward more scalable, software-like revenue streams in factory and warehouse automation.

headlines.title: Accenture accused of publishing research full of AI hallucinations
headlines.summary: Accenture has been accused of publishing research that contained a litany of artificial intelligence hallucinations, amid concerns about the technology’s shortcomings.

description: Accenture plc provides consulting and managed services in the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Asia Pacific. It offers artificial intelligence and data; cloud consulting; cybersecurity consulting; digital engineering and manufacturing; ecosystem partners; emerging technology; finance and risk management consulting; infrastructure and capital projects; digital learning; supply chain consulting; technology consulting; sustainability consulting; and metaverse solutions, as well as customer services. The company also provides proprietary assets and platforms, such as GenWizard, SynOps and reinvention.AI to clients. It serves aerospace and defense, automotive, banking, capital markets, chemicals, communications and media, consumer goods and services, energy, health, high tech, industrial, insurance, life sciences, natural resources, private equity, public service, retail, software and platforms, travel, and utilities industries. Accenture plc was founded in 1951 and is based in Dublin, Ireland.
